features: 2TB MASSIVE STORAGE: This portable SSD offers 2TB of storage capacity, giving you ample space to store photos, videos, documents, and more.
USB 3.1 C-TYPE CONNECTIVITY: Equipped with USB 3.1 Type-C interface for high-speed data transfers, ensuring quick and efficient file management.
INCLUDES USB-C CABLE: Comes with a USB C-Type cable in the box, so you can get started right away without needing any additional accessories.
COMPACT AND PORTABLE DESIGN: The slim and lightweight build makes it easy to carry in your pocket or bag, ideal for use on the go.
SOLID STATE DRIVE TECHNOLOGY: Built with SSD technology for faster read and write speeds compared to traditional hard drives, ensuring reliable performance.
description: Take your data storage to the next level with this powerful 2TB Portable SSD. Designed for those who demand speed and reliability on the go, this compact external solid-state drive offers exceptional performance for transferring large files, backing up important data, and storing your entire media library. Equipped with a USB 3.1 Type-C interface and a USB C-Type cable included in the box, it delivers blazing-fast data transfer speeds that leave traditional hard drives far behind. The rugged, pocket-sized design features a durable outer casing that can withstand the rigours of daily use, making it an ideal companion for photographers, videographers, and professionals who are always on the move. The convenient loop at the top allows you to attach it to a bag or keyring for easy portability. Compatible with a wide range of devices including laptops, desktops, and smartphones that support USB Type-C connectivity, this drive offers seamless plug-and-play functionality with no additional software required. Whether you are archiving 4K videos or managing large project files, this 2TB SSD is built to keep up with your demanding workflow.
